name: Manage a complex daily routine
short_description: Carry out and track a personalised routine with at least five timed non-invasive care actions for 30 days.
self_assessment: I can manage five timed non-invasive care actions for 30 days without help or missed records.
description: Carry out and track a personalised routine with at least five timed non-invasive care actions for 30 days. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Track a multi-step non-invasive care schedule
safety_note: Missed or duplicated care actions can cause harm; use a checked schedule and contact a qualified clinician when instructions conflict or symptoms worsen.
